item.title: Hierarchical interfacial anchoring for durable perovskite solar cells
item.description: arXiv:2611.13746v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Although inverted perovskite solar cells now deliver certified efficiencies approaching their single-junction limits, their practical deployment remains constrained by the thermo-mechanical fragility of buried interfaces under realistic temperature fluctuations.
